name: Dead Field
summary: Forsaken assaults falter at Dead Field, a ruined farmstead in northern Silverpine Forest. Rot Hide gnolls serve the Scourge there, while the banshee Nightlash turns back those who attack.

sections.title: A Blighted Staging Ground
sections.body: The ruined farmstead lies in northern Silverpine Forest, its human occupants lost to the Third War. Rot Hide gnolls now use the plot as a base and willingly serve the Scourge. Deathstalker scouts passing through the region have noted signs of imminent military mobilization that threatens Forsaken supply lines and outposts. Small Forsaken assaults on the farm have repeatedly failed. Each time the gnolls are endangered, Nightlash, a wailing banshee, appears and drives the attackers back.

sections.title: Ravenclaw's Ambition
sections.body: Thule Ravenclaw directs the Rot Hide gnolls from Fenris Isle. The necromancer seeks to establish Scourge dominance over Silverpine and drive Sylvanas's forces from Lordaeron. He sends magical apparitions to the farmstead to survey his undead horde and warn Forsaken intruders.

faq.answer: Dead Field is a ruined farmstead in northern Silverpine Forest. It was once an ordinary human farm, but has fallen into ruin and is now occupied by Rot Hide gnolls aligned with the Scourge.

faq.q: Why are there gnolls at the farm?
faq.answer: The Rot Hide gnolls serve the Scourge and use the farmstead to gather forces and prepare attacks against Forsaken positions in northern Silverpine Forest.
Nightlash is a Scourge banshee who commands the Rot Hide gnolls at the farm. When Forsaken forces attack, she appears to defend her servants and repel their attempts to reclaim the land.

faq.q: Who commands the Scourge forces here?
faq.answer: Thule Ravenclaw, a powerful necromancer based on nearby Fenris Isle, commands the Scourge forces here. He coordinates the gnolls through apparitions and magical oversight to harass Forsaken expansion.

angles.text: For you, the Forsaken, the Scourge foothold at Dead Field threatens the road between the Sepulcher and northern Lordaeron. It calls for swift extermination.
As a rogue, you know Deathstalker recon teams watch the farm closely. Infiltrating the gnoll ranks and striking their command structure is a critical tactical priority.
